recall.minute: First half in one minute: Pre-train with next-token prediction on filtered, deduplicated, tokenized text; C ≈ 6ND (70B × 1.4T ≈ 5.9×10²³ FLOPs); Chinchilla ≈ 20 tokens per parameter. Modern blocks: pre-norm RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, MoE (top-2 of 8 = 25%). Attention softmax(QKᵀ/√d + M)V is n²: 2000 tokens = 4× 1000. Training memory: Adam 16 B/param (1B → 16 GB); mixed precision, sharding, checkpointing; FlashAttention (exact, tiled); Ring Attention. Serving: prefill compute-bound, decode bandwidth-bound; greedy/beam/top-k/top-p/temperature; KV 524,288 B/token (≈1 GiB per 2048 tokens) cut by GQA/MQA/MLA; quantization 4 → 1 → 0.5 GB per billion; speculative decoding (3.36 tokens/pass at α = 0.8, k = 4); continuous batching; paged attention; $5.56 per million at $2/h and 100 tok/s. Fine-tuning: SFT (response-only loss), instruction tuning, LoRA (1.6% at r = 8 on 1000²), QLoRA, merging, distillation, avoid forgetting.
